summary: The figure shows two maps of Rwanda at the subnational level depicting reproductive, maternal, newborn and child health (RMNCH) service coverage for 2019-2020. The left map illustrates the RMNCH service coverage index, with higher coverage in districts like Musanze and Rubavu. The right map shows antenatal care coverage for four or more visits during the last pregnancy, with similar spatial patterns where districts with higher RMNCH index also tend to have higher antenatal care coverage. Coverage varies across districts, with some eastern and southern districts showing lower values.
